results.title: Applying Model-Based Systems Engineering on CubeSat Budget Calculating
results.abstract: This work presents a tool based on Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) for automating the process of budget calculation - mass, volume, power, and energy - for CubeSat nanosatellites based on user input which can be iteratively fine-tuned to fit the CubeSat limitations.
